svg.text: Inventory saw-tooth of CC20-CAST – safety stock 62, reorder point 200, lead time 16 h, lot 240 (EOQ 246)
d = 8.6 pcs/h (17.2 units/h × 0.5); σ_d = 4 /h; σ_LT = 4 h; z = 1.645 (95 %); right: EOQ cost curve with and without the AS/RS slot cost
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
Guide 34 · AS/RS raw materials – WMS / ERP / MES · values = examples (ASRS-RAW, V-compressor factory)
cycle = Q / d = 240 / 8.6 = 27.9 h · 143 orders / year · ROP = d·LT + SS = 8.6 × 16 + 62 = 200
SS = 1.645 × √(16 × 4² + 8.6² × 4²) = 1.645 × 37.9 = 62 (σ_LT gives 1 183 of the 1 439 under the root)
lot 120 (config) would be too small: SS + 120 = 182 < ROP 200 → order on the stock POSITION (on hand + on order), not on hand.
total cost per year $ = D/Q · S + Q/2 · H
